text_block_list.text:
After defeating many formidable
opponents,
Голд Шип finally obtains the
ticket to Eden, only
to find Director
Akikawa waiting for her! Figures!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The truth comes out that the Book of
Secrets was
a plot by Директор Акикава
to keep Голд Шип
excited about racing.
As for Eden, the supposed
Umamusume
utopia...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The director indicates it is in fact the
Twinkle
Series. In other words, Gold
Ship has already
arrived. However, there
is no connection between
Director
Akikawa and the dreams.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Just who is behind the prophetic events, then? Perhaps Голд Шипп can find the answer if she keeps running down the golden path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
